purpose: Distinguish the earliest failed VM, TCP, SSH protocol, authentication, cloud-init, or bootstrap-readiness stage without deploying RouteMind.

approvalBoundary.requiredHumanGate: ROUTEMIND TOKYO VM SSH-READINESS HUMAN GATE

network.consoleChannel: Vultr out-of-band console may retain the sanitized cloud-init marker; no public observer endpoint is created.

sshIdentity.hostKeySource: guest artifact emitted to the provider console or another independently retained out-of-band source
sshIdentity.hostKeyPinningProcedure: Acquire the ED25519 public host key with ssh-keyscan, require its SHA-256 to equal the independently retained console fingerprint, atomically write the exact host binding, then use StrictHostKeyChecking=yes.

records: root SSH directory and authorized_keys permissions
guestReadiness.limitation: If neither strict SSH authentication nor provider-console retention is available, the local guest artifact is not claimable as external evidence and the diagnostic remains incomplete.

rootCauseMatrix.support: both v2 hosts accepted TCP then closed before banner
rootCauseMatrix.contradiction: provider state was active and one reboot was unchanged
rootCauseMatrix.discriminatingTest: guest ssh.service/listener state plus banner timeline

rootCauseMatrix.contradiction: v2 cloud-init had no explicit sshd, network, or reboot command
rootCauseMatrix.discriminatingTest: minimal no-package cloud-init and guest journal/marker

rootCauseMatrix.support: pre-banner close is compatible with daemon failure or a non-sshd listener
key identity was not proven in guest evidence
rootCauseMatrix.contradiction: authorization normally occurs after banner and KEX
rootCauseMatrix.discriminatingTest: fingerprint and permission evidence after strict host-key verification

rootCauseMatrix.support: provider key-to-local-key equality was not retained in v2 target evidence
rootCauseMatrix.contradiction: key rejection normally occurs after banner and KEX

rootCauseMatrix.support: image username semantics require explicit confirmation
rootCauseMatrix.contradiction: username rejection occurs after banner and KEX
rootCauseMatrix.discriminatingTest: freeze image user_scheme=root and classify username rejection separately

rootCauseMatrix.support: sshd may drop unauthenticated connections before authentication
rootCauseMatrix.contradiction: v2 used bounded low-rate attempts on two new hosts
rootCauseMatrix.discriminatingTest: single-client phased polling plus guest sshd effective config/journal

rootCauseMatrix.support: host-key generation can delay sshd on first boot
rootCauseMatrix.contradiction: one bounded reboot did not change v2 behavior
rootCauseMatrix.discriminatingTest: host-key existence timestamps and post-cloud-init marker

rootCauseMatrix.support: firewall was attached to both v2 hosts
rootCauseMatrix.contradiction: exact provider readback passed and TCP 22 connected
rootCauseMatrix.discriminatingTest: one exact /32 rule plus provider readback and TCP/banner split

rootCauseMatrix.support: a host policy can reset pre-auth connections
rootCauseMatrix.contradiction: fresh images and low-rate attempts make accumulated bans unlikely
rootCauseMatrix.discriminatingTest: guest process/rule/journal evidence without changing policy

rootCauseMatrix.support: v2 requested package update and six packages
rootCauseMatrix.contradiction: package activity should not inherently suppress an already-running sshd
rootCauseMatrix.discriminatingTest: no-package diagnostic image and cloud-init completion timeline

rootCauseMatrix.candidate: sshd configuration syntax or startup failure
rootCauseMatrix.support: no guest sshd validation existed in v2
rootCauseMatrix.contradiction: stock Ubuntu image should ship a valid configuration
rootCauseMatrix.discriminatingTest: sshd service state and sshd -t result from guest artifact or strict session

rootCauseMatrix.support: no server banner/KEX and no host-key evidence were retained
rootCauseMatrix.discriminatingTest: host public-key fingerprint and creation timestamp

rootCauseMatrix.support: two instances using the same image showed the same symptom
rootCauseMatrix.contradiction: shared harness and operator path are alternative shared causes
rootCauseMatrix.discriminatingTest: minimal image-isolated run plus provider-console guest evidence

rootCauseMatrix.candidate: operator network middlebox, VPN, or TUN
rootCauseMatrix.support: both connections originated from one operator path
rootCauseMatrix.contradiction: TCP connected and the symptom alone does not prove path interference
rootCauseMatrix.discriminatingTest: provider-console guest readiness combined with operator banner/KEX stages

rootCauseMatrix.support: two fresh active instances had the same pre-banner close
rootCauseMatrix.contradiction: no independent guest or network vantage evidence exists
rootCauseMatrix.discriminatingTest: guest listener readiness plus bounded operator protocol timeline; escalate only with retained provider identities

stopConditions: plan, image, username, key fingerprint, resource count, or firewall boundary mismatch
authenticated quote exceeds USD 1 incremental ceiling
strict host-key source is unavailable before authentication
secret may enter Git, logs, console payload, or evidence
provider behavior cannot be safely reconciled with the exact plan
